questions.markdown:
A boiler produces 1200 kg of steam per hour at a pressure of 12 bar and a dryness fraction of 0.85.

This steam is then passed through a superheater, where its degree of super heat is 150°C above the saturation temperature. The feedwater supplied to the boiler is at a temperature of 40°C.

Determine:

a) The total amount of heat added per hour in the boiler to convert the feedwater into wet steam.

b) The total heat energy absorbed per hour in the superheater to raise the temperature of the steam.

(Assume $C_p = 4.18$ kJ/kgK & $C_{sup} = 2.25$ kJ/kgK)

Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Remember"

A boiler installed in a food processing unit generates 0.85 tons of steam per day at a pressure of 5 bar with a dryness fraction of 0.9. The boiler is equipped with an economizer, which preheats the feedwater to 85°C before it enters the boiler. It is fired using a mixture of biogas and sugarcane bagasse in equal proportions by mass. Calorific value (GCV) of Biogas = 19,500 kJ/kg
And Sugarcane bagasse = 8,500 kJ/kg. If the boiler operates with an average thermal efficiency of 80%, calculate the daily consumption of biogas and sugarcane bagasse.

Assume specific heat of water and superheated steam as 4.187kJ/kg K and 2.25kJ/kg k respectively.

Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Remember"

Compare the functions of an economizer and an air preheater. How do they complement each other in a boiler system?

An open belt drive 10 cm wide connects two pulleys mounted on parallel shafts 2.5m apart. The diameter of driving pulley is 45cm and that of follower is 30 cm. If permissible pull in the belt is limited to 180N/cm of width, find the power that can be transmitted when driving pulley is rotating at 120 rpm also calculate the length of the belt. Assume co-efficient of friction is 0.3.

The shaft from a prime mover consists of six gear wheels A, B, C, D, E & F. Gears B and C are compound gears, as are gears D and E. Gear E meshes with gear F and gear A meshes with gear B which is mounted on the driven shaft. The number of teeth on gears A, B, C, D, E, and F are 30, 45, 60, 72, 84, and 96 respectively. Gear A which rotates at 200rpm in anticlockwise direction. Sketch the arrangement and determine the speed of driven gear and calculate the centre distance between the driver and driven shafts if the module of gears is $2\pi$ mm.
